name: delayed_current_outcomes
definition:
WITH candidates AS (
         SELECT o.child_id,
            o.match_id,
            o.terminal_revision,
            o.segment,
            o.reason,
            o.winner,
            o.organizer_delta,
            o.opponent_delta,
            o.evidence,
            o.completed_at,
            0 AS generation
           FROM private.delayed_outcomes o
          WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT
                   FROM private.delayed_effective_child_corrections x
                  WHERE x.child_id = o.child_id))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT o.child_id,
            o.match_id,
            o.terminal_revision,
            o.segment,
            o.reason,
            o.winner,
            o.organizer_delta,
            o.opponent_delta,
            o.evidence,
            o.completed_at,
            o.generation
           FROM private.delayed_reopened_outcomes o
             LEFT JOIN private.delayed_effective_child_corrections x ON x.child_id = o.child_id
          WHERE x.child_id IS NULL OR x.generation = o.generation
        )
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (child_id) child_id,
    match_id,
    terminal_revision,
    segment,
    reason,
    winner,
    organizer_delta,
    opponent_delta,
    evidence,
    completed_at
   FROM candidates
  ORDER BY child_id, terminal_revision DESC, generation DESC;

name: delayed_current_runback_viewers
definition:
SELECT r.match_id,
    r.viewer
   FROM private.delayed_runback_viewers r
  WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT
           FROM private.delayed_corrections x
          WHERE x.match_id = r.match_id))
UNION ALL
 SELECT r.match_id,
    r.viewer
   FROM private.delayed_reopened_runback_viewers r
     JOIN private.delayed_current_corrections x ON x.match_id = r.match_id AND x.generation = r.generation;

name: delayed_current_settlements
definition:
SELECT s.match_id,
    s.game_id,
    s.dealer_game_id,
    s.result_id,
    s.outcome_hash,
    s.child_count,
    s.organizer_delta,
    s.opponent_delta,
    s.created_at
   FROM private.delayed_settlements s
  WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT
           FROM private.delayed_corrections x
          WHERE x.match_id = s.match_id))
UNION ALL
 SELECT s.match_id,
    s.game_id,
    s.dealer_game_id,
    s.result_id,
    s.outcome_hash,
    s.child_count,
    s.organizer_delta,
    s.opponent_delta,
    s.created_at
   FROM private.delayed_reopened_settlements s
     JOIN private.delayed_current_corrections x ON x.match_id = s.match_id AND x.generation = s.generation;

name: delayed_current_review_events
definition:
SELECT id,
    child_id,
    match_id,
    event_key,
    kind,
    actor,
    round,
    score,
    completed_at,
    receipt
   FROM private.delayed_review_events e
  WHERE (kind <> 'child'::text OR NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT
           FROM private.delayed_corrections x
          WHERE x.child_id = e.child_id AND e.completed_at < x.created_at)) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT
           FROM private.delayed_timeout_restored_children r
             JOIN private.delayed_corrections x ON x.id = r.correction_id
          WHERE r.child_id = e.child_id AND e.completed_at < x.created_at))) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT
           FROM private.board_undo_audits a
             JOIN private.board_undo_frames f ON f.id = a.frame_id
          WHERE a.mode = 'async'::text AND a.match_id = e.child_id AND e.completed_at <= a.created_at AND (e.kind = 'child'::text OR e.round >= ((f.before_row #>> '{state,turn}'::text[])::integer))));

name: delayed_current_finale_seen
definition:

    s.seen_at
   FROM private.delayed_finale_seen s
  WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT
           FROM private.delayed_corrections x
          WHERE x.match_id = s.match_id))
UNION ALL
 SELECT s.match_id,
    s.viewer,
    s.seen_at
   FROM private.delayed_reopened_finale_seen s
     JOIN private.delayed_current_corrections x ON x.match_id = s.match_id AND x.generation = s.generation;

name: delayed_effective_child_corrections
definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (child_id) child_id,
    id,
    generation
   FROM ( SELECT delayed_corrections.child_id,
            delayed_corrections.id,
            delayed_corrections.generation
           FROM private.delayed_corrections
        UNION
         SELECT r.child_id,
            x.id,
            x.generation
           FROM private.delayed_timeout_restored_children r
             JOIN private.delayed_corrections x ON x.id = r.correction_id) corrections
  ORDER BY child_id, generation DESC;
